cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says taxes can be paid electronically through the tax authority's system; 77% of individual returns were filed online in 2023/24.
cells.note: BURS takes individual returns through e-services and Mtax (BWA-001, BWA-004), and 77% of 38,000 individual returns were filed online in the year to July 2024 (BWA-005). No payment through BURS's system is shown, and each rung must be met, so 3 holds.
